use: CC0 Poly Haven lacquered cherry scan supplies metric grain, normal and roughness on independently built scene02 timber. Red/cedar pigment is calibrated separately from the dark scan luminance; darkwood and wet floor retain their prior scan treatment.

materialCalibration.method: Decode via the sRGB texture, divide linear luminance by the measured full-map mean, apply exponent .55 and clamp .52..1.46 as painted grain. Material pigment supplies warm vermilion.

authoredMetalGeometry.construction: Closed revolved annular webs with thick rounded rims, central spindle, stepped roof boot and seated terminal. Nineteen levels follow the photographed taper/spacing; not torus wire loops.
authoredMetalGeometry.finish: Sorin-only gold/bronze use the existing outdoor sky environment, rather than the veranda-local reflection probe. Other metal remains unchanged.
